prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high fidelity Android mobile app design board for Chinese wardrobe app 我的 Lolita, landscape, THREE complete front-facing flat screens side by side, each about390x844 logical ratio. High resolution legible Chinese. No phone hardware, no perspective. Board header “我的 Lolita · 把操作重心还给内容” subtitle “第二轮概念提案 · 示例数据 · 非应用截图”. Elegant refined fashion editorial UI, Chinese skin warm ivory, ink black text, restrained cinnabar primary actions, fine subdued gold rules, tiny plum blossom accents at outer corners only. Nearly solid white ivory content surfaces; do not outline every card in red. Clear information hierarchy, practical density. Serif section headings, sans Chinese reading type and numbers. Every screen bottom EXACTLY four nav items 首页 穿搭 统计 个人. LEFT selected 首页; MIDDLE and RIGHT selected 个人.
LEFT: title 设置价格, back arrow, NO save checkmark top. Small context “物品：玫瑰园连衣裙”. Section 订单价格 with separate full width input rows 商品金额 ¥ 680.00 and 邮费 ¥ 12.00. Total summary “应付总额（含邮费）” “¥692.00”. Section 付款计划 with three compact chips 全款 定金尾款 多段, middle selected. TWO compact stage rows: 定金 ¥200.00 “应付日期：未设置”; 尾款 ¥492.00 “应付日期：未设置”. A quieter text action “重新拆分计划”. Essential note always visible “这里只设置应付计划，实付需另行记录。” Bottom fixed single strong button “保存价格与计划”, safe space above nav. No paid badges, no auto payment.
MIDDLE: title 备份与恢复, back arrow. Primary near-solid card with restrained small archive icon, title 完整备份 · ZIP, tiny 推荐 badge, text “包含记录和图片”, prominent single filled button “导出完整备份”. Below a compact two-row section “其他导出方式”: row 数据备份 · JSON, subtitle 不含图片, trailing chevron; row 表格导出 · CSV, subtitle 仅供查看，不能恢复, trailing chevron. Then separated section “恢复备份”, always-visible consequence text “恢复会替换当前资料，请先导出备份。” and OUTLINED button “选择备份文件”. No fake last-backup time, no cloud sync, no success banner. Enough airy space but no enormous generic empty icon.
RIGHT: title 任务中心 with back and secondary small text 新建. Filters 全部 进行中 待确认 已结束, 全部 active. Section “待确认 · 1” with one compact result card: left thumbnail of complete modest pink lolita dress isolated on neutral gray background, full garment Fit uncut, right title “玫瑰园展示图” badge 待确认, short line “主视图 · 尚未保存”, primary small filled button “核对结果”. Next section “最近任务” row with left thumbnail of same isolated dress, title “裙装展示图”, badge 已完成, text “已确认保存”, link 查看结果. Next row compact failed task title “鞋履展示图”, muted status “已中断”, text “检查原因后再决定是否重试”, outlined 查看原因. No retry button, no percentages. Small secondary expandable row at bottom “后台与息屏说明”. This is fictional state demonstration, not real account. Do not confuse completed with waiting-to-save. Maintain useful semantics of images and action priorities. Refined designer presentation, no extra navigation, no decorative charts, no extra invented fields.

Edit this mobile UI proposal board. Preserve all layout, text, numbers, colors and all three screens. Only fix the third card in RIGHT task-center screen, titled 鞋履展示图 with 已中断: its thumbnail must NOT be a dress and must NOT pretend to show a generated result because this task is interrupted. Replace its dress thumbnail with a quiet small outline shoe icon on a neutral ivory square, clearly a category fallback placeholder. Do not modify the two successful/waiting dress thumbnails above. All other content pixel composition as close as possible.

Create a premium professional high-resolution landscape MOBILE UI comparison board, exactly SEVEN columns by TWO rows, 14 complete narrow full-page screenshots, no perspective or device hardware. Chinese title “我的 Lolita · 备份与恢复” subtitle “七套皮肤浅暗提案 · 概念设计，非应用截图”. Column labels 甜美 哥特 中华 古典 海军 田园 维多利亚. Top row 浅色 bottom 暗色.
All14 screens must have EXACT same content, hierarchy and business meaning: top back arrow with title “备份与恢复”; primary card “完整备份 · ZIP” small 推荐 label, text “包含记录和图片”, SINGLE filled primary button “导出完整备份”; next compact grouped section “其他导出方式” with two rows “数据备份 · JSON” / “不含图片” and “表格导出 · CSV” / “仅供查看，不能恢复”; final separated section “恢复备份” with ALWAYS VISIBLE warning “恢复会替换当前资料，请先导出备份。” and OUTLINED secondary button “选择备份文件”. All screens bottom EXACTLY four tabs 首页 穿搭 统计 个人, 个人 selected. No timestamps, cloud, fake success, modal or extra functions. Use concise legible Chinese and practical Android layout, readable panels, restrained ornament. No photos needed. Near solid surfaces, very quiet backgrounds.
Sweet: blush white / warm deep plum, rounded full curves and bow-like soft archive icon shape, rose actions. Gothic: mist purple / dark plum-black, pointed arch archive silhouette and bevelled panels, crisp lavender actions. Chinese: ivory / deep ink warm brown, roofline archive shape and crossed-fold paper icon, cinnabar, very sparse plum blossom at edge. Classic: pearl / smoky warm charcoal, symmetrical tailored paper and archive forms, wine actions, subtle linear rhythm. Navy: mist blue / deep navy, porthole latch/archive and lighthouse silhouette details, clear blue actions. Country: oat cream / forest black-green, wicker storage archive and folded apron silhouette forms, sage green actions, organic curves. Victorian: ivory / dark walnut, layered arched archive silhouette, restrained brass and burgundy with fine frame detail only on main card. Each identity more than color: distinct clearly legible icon construction and small corner art, still recognizable archive/file/table symbols. The 4 bottom nav semantic shapes house/dress/chart/settings maintain meanings with the same 7 aesthetic languages. Dark themes keep high reading contrast, no white glare and no neon. Avoid huge decorative background and do not repeat elaborate frames around every row. Most space devoted to readable functional content.
